Gifted: Fire.description:
🧬 Fire, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you throw flame jets and bursts out to about five meters, raise a fire screen between you and danger, and give light and heat on demand.
📈 With training: flame lances, signal flares, thrust leaps, fire lanes that stop a spreading blaze, steel-melting white heat, and flame shaped to spare a hostage.
⚠️ Holding back is the real skill: every burn you cause is yours to answer for.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as heat builds inside your own body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Endeavor (Hellflame), Dabi (Cremation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Fire.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Fire family): Scale: flame from the skin, usually palms and forearms. At first: a jet about five meters, a doorway-filling burst, flame a few seconds per push; it lights wood, cloth and fuel; dirty flame makes thick smoke. More needs learned techniques. Limits: water, foam, rain and sealed rooms smother it; fire spreads to what it touches, smoke chokes allies too, and clothes burn unless fireproof. The user resists heat, not smoke, and cannot call back a fire that has caught. Quirk Strain: light: hand flame, short jet; moderate: fire screen, lance, flare, thrust leap; heavy: clearing a fire lane, melting steel; severe: signature move, flame shaped around people. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed public flame is a crime, burning a person assault; even licensed heroes answer for every avoidable burn.
